name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks AI Serverless Quickstart end-to-end. A chat completion was returned from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API. The response received was: "Hola! \n\n*(If you meant the literal translation for the command "Say hello", it is "Di hola").*"
deviations: The quickstart docs specify model "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1", but this model returned a 404 Not Found error ("Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed"). I had to query the available models endpoint to find a working alternative and used "accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2" instead, which successfully returned a chat completion.
